name: Implement pending reconciliation without blind ACK
description: Replace the current reconcilePending behavior that always acks to prevent blocking. The correct behavior: inspect PGlite lifecycle state for each pending entry. If terminal durable state exists in PGlite, ack the Valkey entry. If retry state exists, reschedule/requeue according to policy. If no corresponding durable work exists, quarantine the stream entry — do not dead-letter unknown work unless it maps to a known work item in WorkItemTable.
